hello and welcome to my website! i'm leith, this site's webmaster. i'm a severely overworked teen, and i use they/them pronouns. feel free to call me whatever you like!

this website is my favorite creative outlet, and it's been a real joy of mine to sink my time into it and love it as much as i have. this page is inspired by the Xbox360's Metro UI, a controversial update that happened in 2011. this is the version of the console that i grew up with, so it's also my favorite (obviously).

i'm in my second semester of college studying Music Education (instrumental track)! besides music, my hobbies include coding this website and playing video games.
